252|struct incremental_step
253|{
254|	const char *string_to_parse;
255|	int length;
256|	int char_offset;
257|	enum json_tokener_error expected_error;
258|	int reset_tokener; /* Set to 1 to call json_tokener_reset() after parsing */
259|	int tok_flags;     /* JSON_TOKENER_* flags to pass to json_tokener_set_flags() */
260|} incremental_steps[] = {
261|
262|    /* Check that full json messages can be parsed, both w/ and w/o a reset */
263|    {"{ \"foo\": 123 }", -1, -1, json_tokener_success, 0, 0},
264|    {"{ \"foo\": 456 }", -1, -1, json_tokener_success, 1, 0},
265|    {"{ \"foo\": 789 }", -1, -1, json_tokener_success, 1, 0},
266|
267|    /* Check the comment parse*/
268|    {"/* hello */{ \"foo\"", -1, -1, json_tokener_continue, 0, 0},
269|    {"/* hello */:/* hello */", -1, -1, json_tokener_continue, 0, 0},
270|    {"\"bar\"/* hello */", -1, -1, json_tokener_continue, 0, 0},
271|    {"}/* hello */", -1, -1, json_tokener_success, 1, 0},
272|    {"/ hello ", -1, 1, json_tokener_error_parse_comment, 1, 0},
273|    {"/* hello\"foo\"", -1, -1, json_tokener_continue, 1, 0},
274|    {"/* hello*\"foo\"", -1, -1, json_tokener_continue, 1, 0},
275|    {"// hello\"foo\"", -1, -1, json_tokener_continue, 1, 0},
276|
277|    /*  Check a basic incremental parse */
278|    {"{ \"foo", -1, -1, json_tokener_continue, 0, 0},
279|    {"\": {\"bar", -1, -1, json_tokener_continue, 0, 0},
280|    {"\":13}}", -1, -1, json_tokener_success, 1, 0},
281|
282|    /* Check the UTF-16 surrogate pair handling in various ways.
283|	 * Note: \ud843\udd1e is u+1D11E, Musical Symbol G Clef
284|	 * Your terminal may not display these correctly, in particular
285|	 *  PuTTY doesn't currently show this character.
286|	 */
287|    /* parse one char at every time */
288|    {"\"\\", -1, -1, json_tokener_continue, 0, 0},
289|    {"u", -1, -1, json_tokener_continue, 0, 0},
290|    {"d", -1, -1, json_tokener_continue, 0, 0},
291|    {"8", -1, -1, json_tokener_continue, 0, 0},
292|    {"3", -1, -1, json_tokener_continue, 0, 0},
293|    {"4", -1, -1, json_tokener_continue, 0, 0},
294|    {"\\", -1, -1, json_tokener_continue, 0, 0},
295|    {"u", -1, -1, json_tokener_continue, 0, 0},
296|    {"d", -1, -1, json_tokener_continue, 0, 0},
297|    {"d", -1, -1, json_tokener_continue, 0, 0},
298|    {"1", -1, -1, json_tokener_continue, 0, 0},
299|    {"e\"", -1, -1, json_tokener_success, 1, 0},
300|    /* parse two char at every time */
301|    {"\"\\u", -1, -1, json_tokener_continue, 0, 0},
302|    {"d8", -1, -1, json_tokener_continue, 0, 0},
303|    {"34", -1, -1, json_tokener_continue, 0, 0},
304|    {"\\u", -1, -1, json_tokener_continue, 0, 0},
305|    {"dd", -1, -1, json_tokener_continue, 0, 0},
306|    {"1e\"", -1, -1, json_tokener_success, 1, 0},
307|    /* check the low surrogate pair */
308|    {"\"\\ud834", -1, -1, json_tokener_continue, 0, 0},
309|    {"\\udd1e\"", -1, -1, json_tokener_success, 1, 0},
310|    {"\"\\ud834\\", -1, -1, json_tokener_continue, 0, 0},
311|    {"udd1e\"", -1, -1, json_tokener_success, 1, 0},
312|    {"\"\\ud834\\u", -1, -1, json_tokener_continue, 0, 0},
313|    {"dd1e\"", -1, -1, json_tokener_success, 1, 0},
314|    {"\"fff \\ud834\\ud", -1, -1, json_tokener_continue, 0, 0},
315|    {"d1e bar\"", -1, -1, json_tokener_success, 1, 0},
316|    {"\"fff \\ud834\\udd", -1, -1, json_tokener_continue, 0, 0},
317|    {"1e bar\"", -1, -1, json_tokener_success, 1, 0},
318|
319|    /* \ud83d\ude00 is U+1F600, Grinning Face
320|	 * Displays fine in PuTTY, though you may need "less -r"
321|	 */
322|    {"\"fff \\ud83d\\ude", -1, -1, json_tokener_continue, 0, 0},
323|    {"00 bar\"", -1, -1, json_tokener_success, 1, 0},
324|
325|    /* Check that json_tokener_reset actually resets */
326|    {"{ \"foo", -1, -1, json_tokener_continue, 1, 0},
327|    {": \"bar\"}", -1, 0, json_tokener_error_parse_unexpected, 1, 0},
328|
329|    /* Check incremental parsing with trailing characters */
330|    {"{ \"foo", -1, -1, json_tokener_continue, 0, 0},
331|    {"\": {\"bar", -1, -1, json_tokener_continue, 0, 0},
332|    {"\":13}}XXXX", 10, 6, json_tokener_success, 0, 0},
333|    {"XXXX", 4, 0, json_tokener_error_parse_unexpected, 1, 0},
334|
335|    /* Check that trailing characters can change w/o a reset */
336|    {"{\"x\": 123 }\"X\"", -1, 11, json_tokener_success, 0, 0},
337|    {"\"Y\"", -1, -1, json_tokener_success, 1, 0},
338|
339|    /* Trailing characters should cause a failure in strict mode */
340|    {"{\"foo\":9}{\"bar\":8}", -1, 9, json_tokener_error_parse_unexpected, 1, JSON_TOKENER_STRICT},
341|
342|    /* ... unless explicitly allowed. */
343|    {"{\"foo\":9}{\"bar\":8}", -1, 9, json_tokener_success, 0,
344|     JSON_TOKENER_STRICT | JSON_TOKENER_ALLOW_TRAILING_CHARS},
345|    {"{\"b\":8}ignored garbage", -1, 7, json_tokener_success, 1,
346|     JSON_TOKENER_STRICT | JSON_TOKENER_ALLOW_TRAILING_CHARS},
347|
348|    /* To stop parsing a number we need to reach a non-digit, e.g. a \0 */
349|    {"1", 1, 1, json_tokener_continue, 0, 0},
350|    /* This should parse as the number 12, since it continues the "1" */
351|    {"2", 2, 1, json_tokener_success, 0, 0},
352|    {"12{", 3, 2, json_tokener_success, 1, 0},
353|    /* Parse number in strict mode */
354|    {"[02]", -1, 3, json_tokener_error_parse_number, 1, JSON_TOKENER_STRICT},
355|
356|    {"0e+0", 5, 4, json_tokener_success, 1, 0},
357|    {"[0e+0]", -1, -1, json_tokener_success, 1, 0},
358|
359|    /* The behavior when missing the exponent varies slightly */
360|    {"0e", 2, 2, json_tokener_continue, 1, 0},
361|    {"0e", 3, 2, json_tokener_success, 1, 0},
362|    {"0e", 3, 2, json_tokener_error_parse_eof, 1, JSON_TOKENER_STRICT},
363|    {"[0e]", -1, -1, json_tokener_success, 1, 0},
364|    {"[0e]", -1, 3, json_tokener_error_parse_number, 1, JSON_TOKENER_STRICT},
365|
366|    {"0e+", 3, 3, json_tokener_continue, 1, 0},
367|    {"0e+", 4, 3, json_tokener_success, 1, 0},
368|    {"0e+", 4, 3, json_tokener_error_parse_eof, 1, JSON_TOKENER_STRICT},
369|    {"[0e+]", -1, -1, json_tokener_success, 1, 0},
370|    {"[0e+]", -1, 4, json_tokener_error_parse_number, 1, JSON_TOKENER_STRICT},
371|
372|    {"0e-", 3, 3, json_tokener_continue, 1, 0},
373|    {"0e-", 4, 3, json_tokener_success, 1, 0},
374|    {"0e-", 4, 3, json_tokener_error_parse_eof, 1, JSON_TOKENER_STRICT},
375|    {"[0e-]", -1, -1, json_tokener_success, 1, 0},
376|    {"[0e-]", -1, 4, json_tokener_error_parse_number, 1, JSON_TOKENER_STRICT},
377|
378|    /* You might expect this to fail, but it won't because
379|	   it's a valid partial parse; note the char_offset: */
380|    {"0e+-", 5, 3, json_tokener_success, 1, 0},
381|    {"0e+-", 5, 3, json_tokener_error_parse_number, 1, JSON_TOKENER_STRICT},
382|    {"[0e+-]", -1, 4, json_tokener_error_parse_number, 1, 0},
383|
384|    /* Similar tests for other kinds of objects: */
385|    /* These could all return success immediately, since regardless of
386|	   what follows the false/true/null token we *will* return a json object,
387|       but it currently doesn't work that way.  hmm... */
388|    {"false", 5, 5, json_tokener_continue, 1, 0},
389|    {"false", 6, 5, json_tokener_success, 1, 0},
390|    {"true", 4, 4, json_tokener_continue, 1, 0},
391|    {"true", 5, 4, json_tokener_success, 1, 0},
392|    {"null", 4, 4, json_tokener_continue, 1, 0},
393|    {"null", 5, 4, json_tokener_success, 1, 0},
394|
395|    {"Infinity", 9, 8, json_tokener_success, 1, 0},
396|    {"infinity", 9, 8, json_tokener_success, 1, 0},
397|    {"-infinity", 10, 9, json_tokener_success, 1, 0},
398|    {"infinity", 9, 0, json_tokener_error_parse_unexpected, 1, JSON_TOKENER_STRICT},
399|    {"-infinity", 10, 1, json_tokener_error_parse_unexpected, 1, JSON_TOKENER_STRICT},
400|
401|    {"inf", 3, 3, json_tokener_continue, 0, 0},
402|    {"inity", 6, 5, json_tokener_success, 1, 0},
403|    {"-inf", 4, 4, json_tokener_continue, 0, 0},
404|    {"inity", 6, 5, json_tokener_success, 1, 0},

463|	 * Of course, simply pasting together a stream of arbitrary

493|
494|    /* Check '\'' in strict model */
495|    {"\'foo\'", -1, 0, json_tokener_error_parse_unexpected, 1, JSON_TOKENER_STRICT},

497|    /* Parse array/object */
498|    {"[1,2,3]", -1, -1, json_tokener_success, 0, 0},
499|    {"[1,2,3}", -1, 6, json_tokener_error_parse_array, 1, 0},
500|    {"{\"a\"}", -1, 4, json_tokener_error_parse_object_key_sep, 1, 0},
501|    {"{\"a\":1]", -1, 6, json_tokener_error_parse_object_value_sep, 1, 0},
